channel.title: Crypto Exchange Futures Fee Change Log
channel.description: A dated log of futures fee schedule changes and re-verifications for Binance, OKX, Bybit, Bitget, MEXC, Gate, Kraken, KuCoin and HTX, each entry linked to its official source.

item.title: 2026-09-05 · Kraken · Added
item.description: Kraken Futures tier schedule added: 17 tiers from Tier 1 to Pro 5, verified on the official fee schedule page.

item.title: 2026-09-05 · KuCoin · Added
item.description: KuCoin USDT-M futures VIP schedule added: VIP 0 to VIP 12 with 30-day futures-volume thresholds and the published net-asset routes.

item.title: 2026-09-05 · HTX · Added
item.description: HTX USDT-margined futures Prime schedule added: Prime 0 to Prime 11, Group 1 rates without the HTX-token deduction.

item.title: 2026-07-23 · OKX · Re-verified
item.description: OKX VIP ladder re-checked against the official adjustment notice; no change from the April 8, 2026 schedule.

item.title: 2026-07-23 · Bybit · Re-verified
item.description: Bybit standard VIP and Pro ladders re-checked against the help-center pages updated on May 26 and June 3, 2026.

item.title: 2026-07-15 · Binance · Re-verified
item.description: Binance USDⓈ-M base rate verified at 0.02% maker / 0.05% taker; the full ladder is client-rendered and stays a base-rate reference.

item.title: 2026-07-15 · Bitget · Re-verified
item.description: Bitget standard VIP ladder verified against the schedule effective July 1, 2025.

item.title: 2026-07-15 · MEXC · Re-verified
item.description: MEXC standard perpetual rate verified at 0% maker / 0.02% taker; VVIP uses a dynamic M-Score and is not modeled.

item.title: 2026-07-15 · Gate · Re-verified
item.description: Gate USDT futures base rate verified at 0.02% maker / 0.05% taker after the April 9, 2026 adjustment.

item.title: 2026-06-03 · Bybit · Changed
item.description: Bybit updated its VIP fee-rate help page (Pro tiers and top-72 USDT perpetual group rates).

item.title: 2026-05-26 · Bybit · Changed
item.description: Bybit updated its VIP qualification thresholds page.

item.title: 2026-04-09 · Gate · Changed
item.description: Gate published a futures fee adjustment announcement.

item.title: 2026-04-08 · OKX · Changed
item.description: OKX VIP tier and futures fee adjustment took effect.

item.title: 2025-07-01 · Bitget · Changed
item.description: Bitget VIP fee rates and thresholds schedule took effect.
